v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
text.en: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

text.la: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
text.en: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

text.la: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
text.en: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

text.la: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
text.en: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

text.la: Tu autem, Dómine Sábaoth, qui iúdicas iuste, et probas renes et corda, vídeam ultiónem tuam ex eis: tibi enim revelávi causam meam, Dómine, Deus meus.
text.en: But thou, O Lord of Sabaoth, who judgest justly, and triest the reins and hearts, let me see thy revenge on them: for to thee I have revealed my cause, O Lord my God.

v.la: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo.
v.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.

r.en: Rescue me from the unjust man.

text.la: Vos ascéndite * ad diem festum hunc: ego autem non ascéndam, quia tempus meum nondum advénit.
text.en: Go ye up unto this Feast; * I go not up (yet) unto this Feast, for My time is not yet full come.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, perseverántem in tua voluntáte famulátum: ut in diébus nostris et mérito et número pópulus tibi sérviens augeátur.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee to give us grace to endure to the end in doing of thy will, that in our days thy people which serve thee may have increase, both as touching bettering of their works, and multiplying of their numbers.
